message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/9374/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for interstitial patterns (reticular, nodular) and volume loss indicators to differentiate between fibrotic ILD, organizing pneumonia, and other diffuse lung diseases suggested by the clinical presentation of restrictive function."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/9374/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To extract detailed morphological descriptors (e.g., reticulation vs. ground-glass, cysts, nodules, consolidation) that are critical for distinguishing specific entities like LCH, HP, or CTD-ILD which may share overlapping classifier signals but have distinct visual features."}], "reason": "The question requires differentiating between multiple interstitial and airway diseases based on subtle radiographic patterns (reticular, cystic, nodular, ground-glass) in the context of restrictive physiology.
